idiom_name: class implementing the interface over a Map with a typed journal array
implementation_notes: Structural typing lets the fake be a class (with implements when the interface is wide) or an object literal; the store is a Map and the journal an array of discriminated-union operation values, so nothing of the classic structure has to be built and no framework is needed. Vitest and Jest record calls on spies and mock functions - vi.fn().mock.calls, toHaveBeenCalledWith - but they do not implement the collaborator's behaviour, so they belong to the spy row; keep the hand-written typed journal when the entries are domain operations. Remember that an implements clause is only a compatibility check and does not change the class type, preserve the async signatures of the real collaborator, and create a fresh fake per test instead of exporting a singleton.
pitfalls: implements is only a compatibility check: assign the fake to a variable typed as the collaborator interface to force the check and catch drift.
A module-level Map or a singleton exported from a test helper is shared between suites - export a factory.
Pushing object references into the journal lets later mutation rewrite recorded history; copy or freeze journal entries.
